title: Procurement Activity
description: Replaces the retired Vendor Bidding/RFQ module (migration 0041). One flat record per Requisition + Mode of Procurement, with its own event schedule as child lines instead of one-RFQ-with-nested-fields. Matches public.procurement_activities, with public.procurement_activity_lines embedded as the `scheduleLines` array. Bid Evaluation (vendor-bid.schema.json, rfq-document-checklist.schema.json, rfq-checklist-result.schema.json) and Post-Qualification (post-qualification.schema.json) both anchor on a Procurement Activity now, not an RFQ.

modeId.description: FK -> lookup_options.id, list_key = 'procurement_mode'. The formal method this activity executes under -- should match the Mode already decided on the Procurement Items batched into requisitionId. Branching on this value (e.g. Public Bidding implying a formal bid opening) is not wired up in the app -- the field records the decision, it doesn't drive workflow yet.

scheduleLines.description: public.procurement_activity_lines rows -- one per schedule step (Pre-bid Conference, Opening of Bids, Award, ...).
